detail: 9 e2e tests passed (5 env-source + 4 dynamic file-source). Adds CALLER_MODEL_FILE per-call resolution: proxy re-reads the model file on every tools/call, so switching the file content flips enforcement without restarting the server (verified live: opus->refused, gpt-5-mini->forwarded through one process). File source is preferred over the static CALLER_MODEL env; empty/absent file = passthrough.
